shortcut_removed_ablation_no_modbus_len_.description: Removes modbus_len and packet_size from all representations so models cannot exploit the 100%-precision modbus_len==3 (packet_size==75) signature shortcut and must rely on function-code order, register progression, quantity, and timing.

split_leakage_diagnostic_random_5fold.description: Random 5-fold StratifiedKFold across stride-5 overlapping windows (99.99% of test windows share >=1 packet with training windows). Demonstrates severe optimistic bias relative to capture-independent evaluation, especially when the modbus_len==3 shortcut is removed.

session_id_strict_holdout_diagnostic.description: Strict 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by directional session_id. Because 94.20% (1,769/1,878) of all positive windows occur in session s0004 (185.175.0.5->185.175.0.3 slave responses with func_code=5, modbus_len=3), holding out s0004 deprives the training set of all func_code=5, modbus_len=3 examples (leaving only 109 positives in training), causing recall on s0004 to collapse.
